ConnectionStrings._comment: Leave empty on first run — configured via the Admin Setup page (shared localsettings.json). SQL Server template: Server=.;Database=Dotnetable;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;

Jwt._comment: OVERRIDE SigningKey in production via env var Jwt__SigningKey or a secret. Must be >= 32 chars. Outside Development the app REFUSES TO START while this is unset or still the placeholder below — a wide-open deployment that boots is worse than one that does not.

Cors._comment: Origins allowed to call this API from a browser, e.g. [ "https://shop.example.com" ]. REQUIRED outside Development: an empty list means any origin, and the website key travels in a header, so a wildcard lets any page drive the API with a visitor's credentials.

Hosting._comment: Set true only when this app really sits behind a reverse proxy (nginx, IIS ARR, a load balancer) that rewrites X-Forwarded-For. It makes rate limiting and logging use the real client IP; enabling it without a proxy lets a client forge its own IP and escape the limiter.

DataProtection._comment: Directory holding the data-protection key ring. Must survive restarts and be SHARED by every instance of this app; mount it as a volume in a container. Default: App_Data/keys under the content root.

Internal._comment: Shared secret with Admin's Internal:SyncSecret. OVERRIDE via env var Internal__SyncSecret in production. Guards POST api/cache/invalidate.

Themes._comment: Same Themes root as Dotnetable.Web so active package resolution matches on-disk views.

Cache._comment: Safety-net TTL for cached read services (Menu/Category/Page/Post); tag invalidation on write keeps entries fresh in practice.

Logging._comment: FilePath is the directory for the rolling log files (daily, 31 kept, 64 MB cap each). Default: App_Data/logs under the content root.

_AllowedHosts_comment: Restrict to this API's real host names in production (e.g. "api.example.com") so Host-header attacks cannot reach the app.
